notes: Designs you already saved now set their units the same way: once, when the app loads, every unit in every saved design — in each size layout it has — is made to ride right after its own value's digits (%, °C, GHz, W, mph and the rest), and…

It happens once per design. If you later set a unit free in the designer ('Sits right after' → Nothing), it stays free. New designs, and new Charm clock designs, start with their units and AM/PM already riding.
